title: Training Specialist - Passenger Services - 12-month Fixed-Term contract
description:
Join dnata, a global market leader in ground handling and experience the excitement of working in one of the world’s most dynamic industries!
  
  
**OVERALL PURPOSE OF THE POSITION**
Join dnata as a Training Specialist supporting our Learning & Development team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.
  
  
At dnata we are dedicated to assisting employees reach professional goals through development opportunities.
  
  
As the Training Specialist - Passenger Services, you are responsible for providing ongoing training support on an adhoc and hybrid basis. Working closely with the National Training team and local Management and Service Delivery Supervisor Team, this role will ensure that training is facilitated and organised as per business and client airline requirements.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
The role will provide an opportunity for the successful applicant to gain and apply knowledge, skills and experience to perform the following duties:
  
  

* Train colleagues in an efficient and cost-effective way;
* Liaise with specialist and clients to ensure relevant training and administration resources as used and updated where required;
* Assist the training team to report on training compliance, expiries and recurrence requirements;
* Assist the training team to complete sign-off processes and ensure all applicable team members meet company standards;
* Provide feedback, mentoring and support to buddy’s and SME’s
* Accountable person for completing paperwork and entering into VETrack
* Assist with training document control and document review
* Assist other ports with data entry, as required.
* Assist training department with any ad hoc duties

**Essential Criteria**

* VETrak experience essential
* Currently or willing to be signed off on numerous Passenger Services Functions including: PAX Assist, Check-in and Delta/Gate Supervisor
* High level of computer literacy and sound knowledge of training management systems.
* Well-developed communication skills both written and oral and negotiation skills;
* Sound understanding of the Australian Quality Training Framework and knowledge of all aspects of VET and RTO quality frameworks;

**Desirable Criteria**

* Previous experience in or knowledge of airline industry principles and procedures.

Please note that employment with dnata Airport Services Pty. Limited is conditional upon a satisfactory police/security clearance (ASIC).

title: SNRASSOC, Specialist, COO Office/Business Mgt & Support, Performance/ Financial Planning & Support
description:
* Preparing fortnightly / monthly Financial performance reports for the Technology, Operations and Other units.
* Reviewing business performance (P\&L, BS and non\-financial) and forming objective insights.
* Assisting with the strategic plans, annual budgeting exercise and forecasts.
* Developing cohesive presentations for internal and external forums. This will require active facilitation and teamwork across businesses and functional units.
* Coordinating and developing appropriate performance metric/systems in support of strategic intent (KPI/ Scorecard tracking)
* Creating scalability and efficiency through streamlining and automating reporting processes including monthly Financial forecast submissions to Head Office
* Participating in cross functional project work and new product proposals to help drive the strategic agenda including Strategic Cost Management Initiatives
* Facilitating ad hoc business and internal finance requests
* Executive office reporting on goals/financials and business updates as required and preparation of materials for strategic discussions. Collaborate with multiple Technology and Operations (T\&O) Units for preparation of budget, financial forecasts and report variances
* Prepare and publish timely monthly financial reports for allocated projects (specially on newly amalgamated entities)
* Champion Risk and control culture by analyzing drivers responsible for budget vs actual variance and implement sound controls to curb variation
* Build trust and collaborate with Regional teams across departments for various regulatory and management led deliverables
* Handle vendor consolidation activities related to Technology and Operations
* Maintains a complete and accurate general ledger, financial and management reports
* Unite with different T\&O teams to ensure successful and timely closures of Audit reports
* Innovate and drive Employment Engagement activities within T\&O units and report the engagement to Regional Teams
* Work with CRESA (Real estate team) for managing budget vs. actuals and providing valuable inputs in terms of closing divestment and branch relocation financial requests

 I\-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg

 COO Office/Business Mgt \& Support

title: Career Process Association - Night Shift -US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Career Process Associate – Night Shift – US Process will work full time on\-site at the Rajarhat office. This role involves supporting candidates through the career process, including understanding their profiles, discussing career paths, and guiding them through application, interview, and onboarding stages. The associate will handle inbound and outbound communication with candidates and clients in the US, provide timely information, and ensure a professional and positive experience. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, analyzing candidate fit for roles, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering high\-quality customer service during night shift hours. The role also requires adherence to company policies, process guidelines, and performance targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Career Counseling and Career Development skills to guide individuals through role selection and growth opportunities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication abilities, including clear spoken and written English suitable for US\-based clients and candidates.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess candidate profiles, match them with suitable roles, and interpret process\-related data.
* Candidates should possess proven Customer Service skills to manage queries, resolve issues, and maintain a positive experience throughout the staffing process.
* Comfort with night shift work supporting US processes, with the ability to manage time and workload efficiently.
* Basic computer proficiency, including use of CRM or applicant tracking systems, email, and office productivity tools.
* Prior experience in staffing, BPO, recruitment, or counseling is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.
